notes.title: Chef Chen Official Release Notes
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Gameplay[/b][/h1]

[b][h3]Hunting[/h3][/b] Players must first gather ingredients and hunt various monsters before they can cook. Each chapter ends with a boss stage that tests players' cooking and cooperative skills.
[b][h3]Ingredients[/h3][/b] Most of the ingredients are obtained from monsters, which adds more variety and depth to the gameplay.
[b][h3]Knives[/h3][/b] Knives are limited in number, emphasizing the importance of teamwork. Players must discuss how to use knives efficiently.

[h1]Cooperation[/h1]

[list]
[*] The 30 game levels have more detailed teamwork mechanics. Some hidden areas are carefully designed to allow players to find the best solution to get high scores in the stage.
[*] The game is designed for single-player to multiplayer. Different strategies and gameplay mechanics are provided a ccording to the number of players. Therefore, it also supports single-player mode.[/list]

[h1]Score[/h1]

[list]
[*] Casual players can easily get 1-2 stars after familiarizing themselves with the stage. Players who are looking for a challenge can try to challenge the 3-star difficulty.
[*] Players can unlock new characters and new attack methods by collecting enough stars.
[*] The number of players and the score standard are optimized, so the difficulty of the game is not affected by the number of players.[/list]

[h1]Fixed and modified issues[/h1]
1. The star scores for the first chapter stages 1-1 to 1-6 were adjusted.
2. The star requirements for unlocking the first chapter stages 1-6 were modified.
3. The star scores for the first chapter stages 1-7 to 1-10 were adjusted for one-two stars.

notes.title: Create your Fun-filled party time with Chef Chen on 24th, January!
notes.notes:
Chef Chen is finally here! (Cheers and applause)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39069957/aea1ee6f3f9c4fd75e4928e655320f9da5df4341.png[/img]

The game "Chef Chen", a hunting and cooking collaboration, has undergone multiple updates since its "Early Access" release in 2021. The brand-new version of the game, featuring updated visuals and gameplay, will officially launch on the Steam platform on January 24, 2024! 
The price will also be adjusted to the official issue price.

[previewyoutube=JkYvDQOq_e0;full][previewyoutube=JkYvDQOq_e0;rightthumb][i]"Chef Chen" - New Game Trailer on YouTube[/i][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

In this latest version, players and their friends take on the roles of "Chef Chen" and his companions. They venture into a world filled with monsters, capturing and harvesting ingredients such as wild vegetables. The gameplay involves cooking and baking, requiring players to work together strategically to tackle challenges and complete specific meal tasks. The new version not only enhances the artistic details but also significantly improves the interactive elements during multiplayer sessions, emphasizing a more collaborative gaming experience.

The game offers a range of levels from easygoing to extremely challenging. Players can achieve mission objectives or take on challenging levels through coordinated pacing, effective division of tasks, focused concentration, and seamless teamwork. This local multiplayer game supports up to four players, creating a fun and engaging party game experience where players can switch between playful banter and intense focus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39069957/cd29cdf0805cff16ad991ca65add97e3aad64a17.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39069957/7c6d74ca48ebd0b75eb1dcabf83ff4ae672e47fc.png[/img]

Players will explore fantasy settings such as the Mysterious Forest, Amber Cliffs, and Twilight Deep Sea. Within the time limits of each level, players must cook and serve dishes according to demand. Serving in sequence or rapidly has additional score bonuses, while failing to deliver on time results in deductions. Throughout the cooking process, players must personally hunt monsters and gather ingredients, employing good teamwork and efficiency to score high.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39069957/fdf88f88b816addb07b8d8731dfea6ec1efbab2d.png[/img]

Achieving high scores unlocks not only new maps and levels but also new animal characters. Each animal character possesses a unique fighting style, assisting players in adapting to various changes and challenges in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39069957/124c4973ec1e2663bc80bff2a741b496f924249a.png[/img]

The Nintendo Switch version of "Chef Chen" is currently undergoing development review and is scheduled for release before Q2 2024. Stay tuned to the official fan page for the latest updates.

"Chef Chen" is a game perfect for family bonding and friendly multiplayer experiences. With its cute and polished visuals and a joyful gaming atmosphere, it guarantees a delightful time for you, your family, and friends.

notes.title: Chef Chen - A brand new version is coming!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]The Chinese game name has been changed from "Lao Chen" to "Chef Chen"[/b][/h3]
Chef Chen has undergone a great transformation! From now on, please call him Master "Chef Chen". This experienced chef is ready to take you on a brand new adventure journey.

[h3][b]New levels are waiting for you to challenge![/b][/h3]
Chef Chen and his companions roam the world and embark on an exciting and tense cooking journey. New levels are waiting for you to challenge! Daytime levels, nighttime levels, and satisfying and challenging boss levels allow you to enjoy more kinds of gaming experiences.

[h3][b]New monsters and characters are waiting for you to discover![/b][/h3]
Are you ready to welcome new companions? We proudly introduce the latest member of the Chef Chen team - Pepper, a cute cat character, ready to accompany you on your cooking adventure. In addition, don't miss these charming trash can monsters who professionally handle burnt food, ensuring that your kitchen environment is always clean and tidy!

[h3][b]New continuous serving and combo system[/b][/h3]
Now, you can get higher scores by serving continuously! Show off your cooking skills, continuously serve, and win more points for yourself.

[h3][b]User interface fully upgraded[/b][/h3]
We have fully upgraded the interface of the game to make your gaming experience smoother. The main menu, loading screen, big map selection screen, settlement screen, and tutorial graphics are all carefully crafted to immerse you in the game world.

[h3][b]New music and sound effects bring immersion[/b][/h3]
We not only bring you three new game music, but also add sound effects and special effects when cooking utensils are finished, making you feel like you are in a real kitchen.

[h3][b]Dazzling new opening animation[/b][/h3]
The new version of "Chef Chen" brings you a wonderful opening performance! The new opening animation will make you feel the unique charm of the game from the beginning.

[h3][b]New save system, save game progress anytime, anywhere[/b][/h3]
The new save system is here! No more worrying about losing game progress, you now have three save slots to save game progress at any time. Pause the adventure at any time and continue playing easily.

[h3][b]Game screen optimization, bringing a more beautiful visual feast[/b][/h3]
We have carefully adjusted the game screen to make it more exquisite. The game logo image and character running and attacking animations have all been updated. The progress bar of the kitchen utensils is now more intuitive, and the growth status of the vines has also been optimized. The game background image has been replaced to bring you a richer game world.

[h3][b]Game operation optimization, allowing you to control more smoothly[/b][/h3]
We have redesigned the character control buttons to make it easier for you to control the character. In addition, now you can still attack while holding an item, greatly improving your flexibility in obtaining ingredients.

[h3][b]Other adjustments, bringing you a better gaming experience[/b][/h3]
The character selection system has been updated, making it more convenient for you to choose your favorite character. At the same time, we have carried out score balance adjustments to make the game more challenging. The details of the operation have also been optimized, allowing you to master every detail in the game more accurately.

Are you ready for the brand new version of "Chef Chen"? Come and show off your cooking skills, and embark on a new adventure journey with Chef Chen!

notes.title: The development log #2
notes.notes:
Hi, everybody!

It has been a whole year since the early access version of '' Chef Chen'' was launched. During this period of time, we have collected feedback from all aspects and made a great range of modifications and updates to the game system and art design. This new year, ''Chef Chen'' will present a brand new looks to all players who support us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39069957/a58c14c9e56a65c3d55ab86be71848f18e3959fd.jpg[/img]

Food to hunt
In this revision, we added a combat system. Each character will have its own unique attack method. The various monsters on each level are the preys.  Players have to  obtain the necessary ingredients by hunting. Meanwhile, to match the hunting combat system and the player's operating habits, we also adjust the configuration of the joystick buttons.

Limited kitchen knife availability
You need a kitchen knife, when you want to cut ingredients on the chopping board. When you want to peel off the ingredients from a monster's corpse, you also need a kitchen knife. Now the kitchen knife is no longer a standard equipment for everyone, which means that the collaboration with friends gets even important.

Unique cuisine
Followed with the updated huntable monsters, there are completely different new food orders. The cooking process gets enriched and various that challenges your mutual understanding and creativity.

Brand new story
Why did Lao Chen come to this fantasy world? And who are these animals, and why do they become fellow partners? We have the amazing stories await for you to discover.

The content of this update
1. Brand new 12 levels
2. Remove some original characters
3. Added two unlocked characters
4. Turn off professional skills gameplay
5. Added hunting battle gameplay
6. Optimize and improve game operation

notes.title: "Chef Chen", a coop-cook game. The monsters can be made into delicious dishes!?
notes.notes:
The Taiwan indie dev - buho game, once again to create a new PC party game creation "Chef Chen", is expected for January 18, 2021 officially on the Steam platform. And the promotion video of the game is released now.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39069957/a2e10948f8983508d28764b0505b51afff4f2c55.png[/img]
Game Trailer
[previewyoutube=oHheCQ6Wll8;full][previewyoutube=JcdSDu8r2RY;full][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b]Work together with the great talent of partners for cooking monster dishes in another world[/b][/h1]

The story of the game is set in another world from the chef Chen, because his dog Husky was captured and then he broke into another world. In that place, he met a group of hungry animal partners. Because of the adventure in another world, fighting with monsters will consume a lot of physical strength and magical power. So under chef Chen's exquisite cooking skills, each partner is inspired to show their unique cooking skills. Apart from defeating monsters in the adventure, the most important thing is to work cooperatively to cook a delicious dish. In this way, the partners can enjoy the food, and continue to restore the physical strength and magical power on the adventure each night.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39069957/8296324fbc0ca531969aa2b2efd6ff043710b443.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39069957/f128d351665562d3af916e53e02d4384faf8ef9e.png[/img]

[h1][b]Seemingly simple but rich gameplay level[/b][/h1]

The main features and gameplay of the game, "Chef Chen" is a 2D local, steam remote play and multiplayer co-op cooking game. Although it is a party game, it is also fun for one person, and supporting up to four people at the same time, the most fun is cooking together! The game process tests the tacit understanding between players, although it is 1) Repetitive meal making: take→cut→cook→dish→serve those five steps, but the game is not only as simple as completing the order, because of the other 2) The role played by each player has its own skills. For example, the character Chef Chen has superb cooking skills, so the cooking speed is very fast than others, which can shorten the cooking time of food. Next is 3) Each level also has its own characteristics. Players will familiarize with the game from simple terrain levels at the beginning, and slowly advance the players to challenge increasingly complex terrain levels. The process is tactical and full of challenges. There are also 4) Some route strategies can be carried out when multiplayer players, and finally 5) There must be a tacit understanding of the working cooperation between players, so that this seemingly simple cooking game is full of people who want to continue Challenge the motivation to complete more meals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39069957/c2a7646831f2796e4f0b153a1a5664698ce3c558.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39069957/6effffbabce80408a3014898342200b69703b5d4.png[/img]
Each character has a its skill, and the good use of skills and strategies can make the cooperative cooking process more efficient

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39069957/5ed7175499f2444b9ff67f1023586768347081e2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39069957/e8c85fe36ee9adec3f6ec575e54ce03cc4750e30.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39069957/cdf74e358aac79d5c428734ea6ce5d0d7926f5e3.png[/img]

[h1][b]Incredible teammates or Impossible teammates?[/b][/h1]

As long as you keep practicing and mastering the key points in the game, you will have a better chance to complete the most meals in a limited time! Therefore, this is a process that tests the game operation and tacit understanding between players or friends.
